payload.instruction: Interpret the CURRENT utterance and resolve the exact ORIGINAL source referent IDs, separating supporting explanation from referred targets. Return JSON {adoption:{targets:[string],intent:string},mode:'COMPLETE'|'READ',answer:{targets:[source ID strings],text:string,facts:[{statement:string,source_id:string,revision:number,start_line:number,end_line:number,quote:string}],source_revisions:[{source_id:string,revision:number}],conditions:[string],uncertainties:[string]},reads:[{source_id:string,start_line:number,end_line:number}],reason:string}. The intent is the concrete requested handling, not a generic acknowledgement. You may adopt identifiable targets before factual details are read. COMPLETE is legal only from actual supplied evidence or actually delivered facts. Metadata alone is NEVER source facts. Supply a bounded substantive answer satisfying the user's actual request, never merely repeat its referent phrase. Each fact claim cites an exact quote from actually supplied evidence, its current revision and inclusive one-based source provenance. The displayed text may paraphrase fact claims. ACTUALLY_DELIVERED_ANSWER is derived previous displayed text, not a verbatim original: quote only its actual text and preserve its separate original source provenance. The quote must be copied exactly (including punctuation) from a supplied evidence.text. Include at least one fact per target and only currently delivered explanation lines. If missing detail, READ necessary bounded ranges. A later fact may need an original read even if recent answers concern that source. Do not invent IDs or values. Preserve unknowns and correction scope.
